description.value: Patisserie Le Pont is a premium French-Japanese artisan pastry shop in West Vancouver, founded by Makoto Yamaguchi, a classically trained pâtissière who graduated from Le Cordon Bleu in Paris and previously ran her own shop in Tokyo for 15 years. The patisserie specializes in handcrafted eclairs — both sweet and savoury — alongside cakes, tarts, and baked goods made fresh daily without preservatives or pre-mixes. OSM records both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a pleasant stop for a cyclist looking for a quality sweet treat.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: bollard (18 spaces) at 22m; rack (4 spaces) at 53m; stands at 93m; stands (4 spaces) at 97m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Patisserie Le Pont is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (230 15th Street, West Vancouver, BC V7T 2X4) and adds a phone number (236-335-0019) not present in OSM. The business is clearly open and active, selling artisan eclairs, tarts, and cakes with a Shopify-powered online store and copyright 2026. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 236-335-0019 sourced from website only and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible specialty bakery with an operational website and confirmed address. A useful stop for touring cyclists wanting fresh pastries or a rest at their outdoor seating.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags confirm indoor_seating=yes and outdoor_seating=yes, which may be useful for cyclists looking for a rest stop.
